findings.evidence: T020 (parallel-execution and resource evidence) acceptance 2 speaks of 'a conservative required-speedup threshold ... met by the recorded values or the shortfall is surfaced honestly'. chip.md#6 declares 'Do not require timing or speedup evidence to finish this project' and the acceptance scope is correctness_only. As written the acceptance is a disjunction, so it does not gate completion on emulator scaling, but the 'required-speedup threshold' wording invites reading it as a pass bar.
findings.required_change: T020's implementer should keep the speedup figure strictly record-only (an honest observation with the shortfall surfaced), never a completion condition; the binding acceptance remains the per-count PASS comparisons, worker split and overlapping-interval evidence.
